chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Whoever adheres to the religion of a people is bound by their rulings.

key_terms.أَحْكَامُهُمْ: their rulings; the legal judgments and regulations belonging to them
key_terms.بِدِينِ: by the religion; the religious system or creed being followed
key_terms.قَوْمٍ: a people; a community or group
key_terms.لَزِمَتْهُ: became binding upon him; was incumbent on him
key_terms.يَدِينُ: adheres religiously; follows as a matter of religion

ai.seo_question: Is a person who follows a community's religion bound by that community's legal rulings?
ai.summary: This hadith states that a person who affiliates with and follows the religion of a given community is subject to the legal rulings associated with that religion. In the context of marriage law, it expresses a jurisprudential principle concerning the binding force of communal religious law upon its adherents.
